title: TSM Advanced Detection: Governed Life-Safety Intelligence
_note: Scripted scenario: engine outputs are canned via tests/e2e/helpers/stub-war-room.js, not live model output. Captions are DRAFTS. Narration lines are DRAFTS too: spoken text for --narrate, numbers written as words.

states.caption: Advanced Detection war room
states.narration: This is the Advanced Detection war room. It turns an early warning into a decision, while there is still time to act. What follows is a simulated incident.

states.caption: BESS off-gas event report loaded
states.narration: Off-gas sensors in Battery Hall B are in alarm on two of six zones. The operator loads the event report.

states.caption: Six engines complete: risk scored 74/100
states.narration: Six engines assess it. This is a warning before thermal runaway, with escalation projected in forty-five to ninety minutes. Exposure runs from one point two to two point four million dollars. The risk score is seventy-four out of one hundred.

states.caption: Operations Strategist receives the detection relay
states.narration: The Operations Strategist receives the case in one click, with the analysis intact, and the exposure projected both ways.

states.caption: Executive Portal with the detection relay
states.narration: The Executive Portal shows the decision: isolate racks four through six in Hall B within one hour, for twenty-five thousand dollars. The system recommends. The site safety lead decides.
